title: Human and VLM PANAS ratings of ten immersive urban environments (data and code)
description: Human PANAS ratings (84 participants, ten 360° urban scenes viewed in VR, de-identified) and repeated PANAS ratings from 45 vision-language models (raw API logs, run-level ratings), the prompt, blurred and metadata-free panoramas, and the full analysis code and results (final batch 20261101_103808) supporting the paper “Human and VLM PANAS ratings of ten immersive urban environments”.
